shape: C with a large rectangular platform + narrow bridge to a smaller square platform
description: C-shape: the wide east section is a large rectangular combat platform (entered from spawn_east on its east edge); the smaller west section is a square platform (entered from spawn_north on its south edge). The two platforms are connected by a narrow bridge running along the north side of the room — bridge anchors at the NW corner of the east platform → mid-bridge → NE corner of the west platform. All other paths between platforms are void.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-9.62, -23.24) — south side of the west platform
portals.east: spawn_east at (22.77, -2.01) — east side of the east platform

traversalNotes: MULTI-PLATFORM TOPOLOGY with bridge: a LARGE east platform (clique of 7 anchors covering combat floor) and a SMALLER west platform (5 anchors), joined by a single narrow bridge along the north side: east_plat_nw / east_plat_n ↔ bridge_mid ↔ west_plat_ne. Voids fill everything else between the platforms.

Direct east → north: spawn_east → east_plat_e → east_plat_nw (or _n) → bridge_mid → west_plat_ne → west_plat_w → west_plat_sw → west_plat_s → spawn_north. Cross both platforms diagonally; the dispatch rule lets the autopilot pick any axis-aligned corner-to-corner traversal on the east platform clique.
Direct north → east: reverse of above.

PER-PLATFORM CLIQUE on the east platform: every corner connects to every other corner so any objective on the east platform is one hop from any other east-platform anchor. Same dispatch rule as ic3/lb1 — enter anchor, jump to objective anchor, jump back, exit.
BRIDGE IS NARROW: solver must NOT emit any cross-platform edge except through bridge_mid (wgxzc7). Off-bridge crossing is void.

Switch / fence hint: the bridge is the obvious choke point — expect fences across the bridge and a switch on the platform the autopilot must traverse first (typically east, since spawn_east enters there). Pre-switch route exhaustively covers east platform corners.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions here are stage-local mesh-space XZ.
